title: Attack
description:
You make an {{attaque}} against a creature within range, with a weapon you have equipped or with your bare hands.

This {{attaque}} uses the {{jet}} the weapon prints. On a success, the target takes the weapon's {{degats}}.

***Unarmed.*** Your {{attaque}} ({{force}} + {{melee}}) targets a creature within 1.5 m of you. On a success, the target takes {{1d4 degats-contondant}}.
